posts.text: Briefing finds no evidence Beijing orchestrated Jensen Huang affair, despite partner’s contact with Chinese spy agency No evidence has been found that China directed the woman who had an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to spy on him, according to United States intelligence officials. Per the Wall Street Journal, U.S. congressional staffers participated in a highly classified briefing on Tuesday, in which they received a broad overview of the investigation’s findings. Current evidence collected by the U.S. found that Alice Huang and Jensen Huang’s relationship was likely amorous, not a coordinated operation by China in an effort to gain traction in the race for advanced Super Intelligence (SI) chips. Allies of the CEO maintain that there is not enough evidence to prove Alice Huang was a spy or that Nvidia was aware of any alleged chip-smuggling schemes into China. @americanmajority
